Official fixed contest spread as a point-location benchmark. This is not a closing sportsbook quote, probability forecast, or historical contest entry. Later recovery of a line does not establish pregame possession.

2026-centered skill against the same official lines

Current / prior / earlier season weights: 50 / 35 / 15, equal thirds, and 70 / 20 / 10. Compare only each model against its identical-cohort official line; cross-model sample sets differ. A negative error reduction means the model had larger margin error than the official line. Intervals use paired week clusters within seasons and remain descriptive, without multiplicity correction.
